svg.title: Agent patterns by run frequency and risk
svg.desc: The five production agent patterns in order of how often they run and how wide their blast radius is: retrieval-augmented single-loop agents run once per request with the smallest blast radius, then multi-turn conversational agents, workflow orchestration agents, supervisor-delegation agents that split work across several agents, and persistent-goal agents that run continuously and carry state across days with the widest blast radius and the hardest audit.
svg.text: // AGENT PATTERNS BY RUNFREQUENCY AND RISK
